summary: Pampa Energía S.A. (Pampa Energy Inc.) furnished a Form 6-K on November 3, 2026, carrying its third-quarter 2026 results call materials as Exhibit 99.1. The exhibit is a general background investor presentation with standard forward-looking-statement disclaimers; no transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor or closing date is disclosed. This is a routine foreign-private-issuer earnings communication, the equivalent of a US earnings release/8-K results item, not a special situation. No deal terms, overhang or regulatory clock to monitor; risk-arb angle is not applicable.
